anomalies: Frame timestamps are uniform (1/24 s) but every falling object jumps about twice its expected step between frames 35 and 36 (soccer ball 26 -> 66 -> 36 px; lemon 54 -> 119 px; white box 29 -> 66 -> 45 px): a capture frame was very probably dropped between 35 and 36, so the real time gap 35->36 is ~2/24 s. Frame-diff energy also peaks at 35->36. The benchmark convention still maps time t to frame round(t*24).
